title: Recover access to In Falcone Console
intro: Request instructions to recover a console account. For security, the response does not confirm whether the user exists.
help: Enter the username or email associated with your console account.
successMessage: If there is an eligible account, we will send instructions to the configured email. Check your inbox and spam folder.
invalidTitle: We could not validate the request
invalidMessage: Check the username or email and try again.
deniedTitle: Recovery is not available for this account
deniedMessage: Recovery cannot be started with those details. Contact the platform operator if you need access.
missingTitle: Recovery is not enabled in this environment
missingMessage: The password recovery service is not yet enabled in this environment. Return to login or contact the platform operator.
restrictedMessage: Wait a few minutes before requesting instructions again.
serviceTitle: The recovery service is currently unavailable
serviceMessage: An operational error occurred. You can retry shortly without reloading the console.
asideDelivery: Instructions are sent only to the destination configured for the account and expire automatically.
asideOperator: If you cannot access the recovery email, contact the platform operator.
